name: AXM Review & Promotion Inbox
actions: submit an exact artifact for review
queue one to ten independent seats
discuss a held or rejected item
send an item to changed-digest repair
summary: One durable queue for exact-artifact review, one-to-ten independent seats, discussion, repair routing, cancellation, holds, rejection and digest-bound approval.
notes: Approval never applies an action by itself. The consuming service must verify the approved digest again.
